jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(A) inventory: Cabot School District, a town school district in the Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (member town: Cabot).

sources.note: Cabot School District board members page (official): five directors -- Chris Tormey (Chair, term expires 2028), Ellen Cairns (2029), Alicia Heber (Clerk, 2027), Jason Monaco (2028), Melissa Pratt (Vice-Chair, 2027). The same five sit in the March 23, June 22 and September 28, 2026 board minutes with none absent.

Cabot School District official ballot results (district budget page): March 4, 2025 -- Chris Tormey elected to the 3-year seat (301) and Melissa M. Pratt to the 2-year seat (307); March 3, 2026 -- Ellen Cairns to the 3-year seat (326) and Jason Monaco to the 2-year seat (303). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b): three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats).
